payload.title: Editorial board themes in @kanbus/ui with console theme picker
payload.description: Add four editorial board themes (refined-newsprint, newspaper-gothic, night-desk, broadsheet-green), each light and dark, as token-driven CSS in @kanbus/ui with KANBUS_THEMES and KanbusThemeScope exports; retire the newsprint theme; console Settings picks the theme. Release @kanbus/ui 0.4.0.
